asks: When do the rules and secrets that a recipe in a repository names take effect?
answer: A recipe whose source sits in a repository may name the rules and secrets its computer needs. They are proposals: Silo shows them, switches them on only with your yes, and asks again whenever they change. Silo stores the recipe it built from that source, as a property of the computer. The rules in force are kept by the engine, and never read from the repository.
